description: React context provider for user state management, including profile, orders, cart, and notification tokens, utilizing Apollo Client for GraphQL queries and subscriptions.

classes.name: UserContext
classes.description: React context for user data and state sharing across components.

methods.name: UserProvider
methods.description: Main React component providing user state and actions via context.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Callback for GraphQL query completion, triggers notification token update if profile exists.

methods.name: setTokenAsync
methods.description: Sets authentication token asynchronously and stores it in localStorage.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out user by clearing token and resetting Apollo client store.

methods.name: subscribeOrders
methods.description: Subscribes to order status changes via GraphQL subscription.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears cart and restaurant data from state and localStorage.

methods.name: addQuantity
methods.description: Increases quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: removeQuantity
methods.description: Decreases quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: checkItemCart
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the cart and returns its quantity and key.

methods.name: numberOfCartItems
methods.description: Calculates total number of items in the cart.

methods.name: addCartItem
methods.description: Adds a new item to the cart with specified options.

methods.name: setCartRestaurant
methods.description: Sets the current restaurant in state and localStorage.

methods.name: updateNotificationToken
methods.description: Sends notification token to server if available.
